DoneEvent, RunSummary with the summary still final (D6.1); the wire still carries run_summary before done, so no compatibility surface moves (D8); and D6.3's agreement is now decidable over the returned trace alone, which dst_invariants.outcome_agreement_findings reads. The alternative — reclassifying it DisplayOnly — was refused: DisplayOnly means 'cannot change invariant results', and D6.3 is an invariant over precisely this event's content, so the reclassification would have made D6.3 unstatable rather than satisfied.
